response: original day-normalized Q_78; no overnight, split-only SPY
features: Z0=log(R of immediate scheduled valid ordinary predecessor)

modes.D_FULL: all explored 1472 days, descriptive fit and retrospective P0 reference
modes.DEV_CHRONO: two past-only development-era backchecks; previously explored, not independent validation

S0: C1R fit_s0 linear empirical terciles; boundary ties upper; origin training only
P0_labels: D_ONLY fixed-rank reference; not reused for chronological model categories

models.P-OLS-TIME: algebraic alias of M0, no duplicate fit
models.P-OLS-Z: time-specific intercept and numerical state slope; 2x78 multioutput OLS
models.M2: cubic clamped uniform B-spline at k0..77; 8 primary,12 sensitivity; intercept in spline span
models.M4: nonredundant Bz(4) x Btime(8 or12) tensor; unpenalized full-rank least squares
models.state_basis: four natural cardinal cubic knots at train min,1/3,2/3,max of standardized Z0; linear extrapolation
models.ablation: same time/state bases, centered additive main effects, no tensor; not EBM M3
models.rank_failure: ABSTAIN, no p-values; stop affected core path
models.postprocessing: NONE; raw output mandatory, no clipping, M8 not fitted

support.blocks: distinct original scheduled-session index//5 groups, not independent units
support.M1_fallback: M0 if any applicable train cell fails basic gate; flag dates
support.grid_local_support: training quantile rank band +/-0.1; display gate

sensitivity.DROP_TOP1_RV: ceil(.01*N) highest current R, date tie-break; D-only
sensitivity.DROP_TOP5_INFLUENTIAL: five highest Cook values from D_FULL OLS-L1, date tie-break; shared keys
sensitivity.transform_policy: refit training scalers/knots/cuts per changed training cohort; raw reference keeps P0 labels

inference.HAC: Bartlett calendar-score NW; n/(n-p); normal coefficient intervals; missing slots zero scores only
inference.bootstrap: joint circular scheduled-date slots; fixed labels/forecasts, no learner refit
inference.P0_intervals: reuse matching fixed-label block5/10 windows; new direct20 only
inference.paired_scope: each 2020/2021 year and pooled matched fixed forecasts; HAC and blocks 5/10/20
inference.adjustment: Holm within this six-member D_FULL exploratory family only; not protection from prior P0 selection
inference.diagnostics: OLS reference tests heuristic under dependence; no flattened-bin IID inference
inference.certification: NONE; no theorem or raw pointwise population confidence event

environment_reweighting: NONE; same training-defined quintile cells only
last_bin_diagnostic: leave 15:55 bin out of closing numerator without renormalizing; changed estimand
announcement_diagnostic: k54:56 (14:00..14:10) post-P0 exploratory; no event calendar claim
